visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens on a large, glowing TV screen in a dimly lit living room, showing a live World Baseball Classic game. Players in white and green uniforms are visible on the baseball diamond, with the pitcher mid-delivery and the catcher squatting behind the plate. The stadium environment is rendered in vibrant colors with clear floodlighting against a dark sky. (2) As the batter swings and hits the ball, the TV camera pans quickly across the field, showing players in blue uniforms scrambling to field the grounder and making a play at the base. The motion is sharp and dynamic, highlighting the players' physical exertion and the focus on the white baseball moving across the green turf. (3) In the foreground, a human thumb is raised in a celebratory gesture, with the hand skin texture visible as it partially obscures the lower right portion of the TV screen. On the screen itself, the players in blue are seen high-fiving and hugging each other, while the surrounding residential room remains out of focus and dark.

By filming the live broadcast and adding enthusiastic text overlays like 'Taiwan won' and 'Too exciting,' the creator shares their joy and national pride, reinforced by the audible clapping and the visual thumbs-up gesture.
